description: A tuple for expression whose condition isn't a bool takes no part in unifying when not selected
notes: The spec says errors in the result that isn't selected aren't passed through, and that both results must unify, but not what type a failed result has. hashicorp/hcl evaluates both results (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), and ForExpr.Value gives the dynamic value when a condition can't convert to bool. Because one result has the dynamic pseudo-type, it skips unification and returns the selected result unconverted.
